Summary Collaboration Themes: This collaboration bridges Xiangming Xiao’s mechanistic ecological modeling (avian telemetry, remote sensing, biophysics) with David S. Ebert’s predictive data science and non-invasive diagnostics (breathomics, visual analytics, interpretable AI). The core synergy lies in transforming static ecological observations into dynamic, causal early-warning systems for zoonotic spillovers. By fusing high-resolution host movement and environmental data with real-time human biomarker and syndromic surveillance, the partnership aims to identify specific environmental drivers of disease emergence, enabling targeted, evidence-based public health interventions in urban and agricultural One Health contexts.
